verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents an official Woo Marketplace with hundreds of free and paid extensions that add features and functionality, plus 140 region-specific payment gateways, so the core long-tail extension marketplace is clearly delivered. Nothing in the pack shows that marketplace extensions are vetted or reviewed. missing for 10: documented vetting/review process for marketplace extensions, evidence of long-tail category coverage beyond payments, independent or hands-on corroboration of marketplace quality.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can extend my store from a marketplace of vetted apps and extensions covering the long tail of features

citations.quote: The Woo Marketplace has hundreds of free and paid extensions that add features and functionality to your store
Grow your business with hundreds of free and paid extensions
Beyond the basics, there are 140 region-specific gateways
